limits: Native implementation F and other unbound native pairs remain unsupported; no fallback to a different family.
Source mapping does not guarantee current-adapter permissions, actual request execution, complete gating coverage, physical gating, residency or power savings.
Runtime capability, identity, packet geometry and independent readbacks remain mandatory; there is no driver-version or board-ID allowlist.
Requests are session-only and are never automatically reapplied after a GPU driver restart. No recovery/profile integration is added.
